description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. It can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.
